title: 🕉️ Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa 5 Minutes | Original Devotional Song & Sabarimala Darshan | Full HD 1080p
description:
॥ ॐ स्वामी शरणम् अय्यप्पा ॥ • ॥ ॐ श्री हरिहरपुत्राय नमः ॥

Experience the cosmic divine grace and epic pilgrimage of Lord Sri Ayyappa Swami (Dharma Sastha) in this 5-minute continuous Full HD master movie. Set to the legendary, authentic devotional song 'Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa / Pallikattu Sabarimalaikku' by K. Veeramani, featuring classical oil painting human-form aesthetics: the celestial union of Lord Ayyappa and Lord Murugan (Kartikeya), Prince Manikandan fearlessly riding the Royal Tigress (Pulivahanam), the slaying of demoness Mahishi, devotees carrying the sacred Irumudi through misty ancient forests, the holy ascent of the 18 Golden Steps (Pathinettampadi), the supreme Chin-Mudra darshan, and the celestial Makara Jyothi!

✨ CLASSICAL OIL PAINTING MASTERWORK & CINEMATIC CAMERA CHOREOGRAPHY
🔥 100% PURE AUTHENTIC SACRED DEVOTIONAL MUSIC • ZERO CINEMATIC REMIX
🛡️ EMBEDDED DIVYA MANGALAM PROTECTIVE WATERMARK
🔔 Full HD 1080p Landscape Widescreen (16:9) Darshan

📖 8 CANONICAL ACTS OF AYYAPPA SWAMI:
00:00 • Act I: ॐ श्री हरिहरपुत्राय नमः (Celestial Union of Lord Ayyappa & Lord Murugan)
00:37 • Act II: पुलिवाहन महाप्रभो (Prince Manikandan Riding the Royal Tigress)
01:15 • Act III: महिषीमर्दन वरद (Slaying of Demoness Mahishi on River Azhutha)
01:52 • Act IV: स्वामिये शरणम् अय्यप्पा (Pilgrims Carrying Sacred Irumudi through Forest)
02:30 • Act V: पम्पातीर विहारिणे (Infant Manikandan Discovered at River Pampa)
03:07 • Act VI: अष्टादश सुवर्ण सोपानम् (Reverent Ascent of the 18 Sacred Golden Steps)
03:45 • Act VII: ॐ स्वामी शरणम् (Supreme Darshan of Lord Ayyappa in Sacred Chin-Mudra)
04:22 • Act VIII: मकरविलक्कु • हरिवरासनम् (Sacred Makara Jyothi & Harivarasanam)

॥ स्वामिये शरणम् अय्यप्पा ॥
पल्लिकट्टु शबरिमलैक्कु कल्लुम् मुल्लुम् कालिर्कु मेत्तै
स्वामिये अय्यप्पो ! अय्यप्पो स्वामिये !
हरिवरासनम् विश्वमोहनम् हरिदधीश्वरम् आराध्यपादुकम्
अरीविमर्दनम् नित्यनर्तनम् हरिवरासनम् शरणमस्तु ते ॥

Swami Saranam! Ayyappa Saranam! 🚩
